en: Black‑and‑white vintage photograph of a simple church building with a tall, steep spire and a rectangular tower. The tower facade has the year "1932" written across the top just under the roofline, and small arched windows. The church has plain plastered walls, a gabled roof, and a modest classical entrance with a triangular pediment. Trees partially obscure the lower part of the building; the sky is lightly clouded. The image has a white border with scalloped edges typical of old postcards or prints.
